title: 다른 방문 방의 미회수 봉인 보스를 봉인 없음/HP·ATK100%로 공개한다
cause: facility_view iterates current and visited room maps, but node_entry_preview calls sealed_golden_bough, which searches only run.map and state.current_room_id. A visited-room node therefore resolves None and exposes an unsealed100% snapshot.
reproduction: Supported authored catalog: B1-01 optional normal-boss slots1/3, both weighted plans contain slot1; two same-depth rooms connected bidirectionally; existing SavePoint2/maintenance5/shop8 route.
Normal package_official and content_pack::load succeed; public starter selection begins at deterrence12.
Observe slot1 sealed=true,HP/ATK150%; complete2/5/8/G and move toB1-02 without entering or defeating either boss.
At balance9 the facility overview still marks the B1-01 bough uncollected/reachable, but both activity and map-node entry_preview report sealed=false,HP/ATK100%.
Complete B1-02 route and return at balance6. Same node/plan/collection state again reports sealed=true,HP/ATK150%. All observed balances remain restrained; no battle/collection took place.
expected: A prospective public preview of a visited room resolves that room/node original sealed bough and authored multiplier. Room movement alone cannot remove a seal or reduce the advertised stats.
impact: Player/consumer planning from the whole-facility map underestimates the reachable sealed encounter. The probe does not establish a combat-settlement, reward-duplication, or persistence defect.
correction_boundary: Correct room/node context in U14 public projection; preserve the current-battle settlement owner, receipt/cost semantics, hidden-encounter policy and revival exclusion. Add/reexecute affected public query and room-roundtrip regression, freeze successor as required, then separate independent re-audit.
